name: eson
description: ESON — ExtendScript Object Notation: a strict JSON parser/stringify library for ExtendScript (ES3) engines

scripts.estc:check: node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESON.jsx dist/vendor-eson.js dist/ESON-runtime.jsx dist/vendor-eson-runtime.js dist/ESON.facade.jsx dist/ESON.accel.jsx dist/ESON.accel.min.jsx --no-target
scripts.estc:live: node ../extendscript-toolchain/bin/estc.mjs check dist/ESON.jsx dist/vendor-eson.js dist/ESON-runtime.jsx dist/vendor-eson-runtime.js dist/ESON.facade.jsx dist/ESON.accel.jsx dist/ESON.accel.min.jsx --no-target --live --launch
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:vendor && npm run test:poly
scripts.release:gate: npm run verify && npm run fuzz && npm run build:accel:strict && npm run estc:check && npm run estc:live && npm run live-verify && npm run live-artifacts && npm run accel-live
scripts.release:integration: npm run vendor-sync && npm run vendor-sync-check
scripts.verify:engine: npm run estc:live && npm run live-artifacts && npm run accel-live
scripts.ci:local: npm run ci:static && npm run verify:engine
